summary: Iteration 27: Security, Password Management & Admin Governance. Fixed JSX syntax error in Profile.js (unclosed fragment). All backend API tests pass 19/19. All frontend UI flows verified.

ui_bugs.issue: JSX syntax error: `` for outer profile-page div was placed inside the `{activeTab === 'profile' && (<>` fragment, causing build failure. Fixed by restructuring the fragment close `}` to come before the ``, and moving the OTP Dialog outside the fragment.

critical_code_review_comments: Profile.js had a broken JSX structure: the outer `<div data-testid='profile-page'>` was closed INSIDE the `{activeTab === 'profile' && (<>` fragment, causing a compile-time JSX error. Fixed.
session_version mechanism in shared.py works correctly - tokens issued before password-change/logout-all are properly invalidated.
2FA is a setup framework only (no enforcement on login) - this is intentional per the feature spec.
AdminUsers page does not show an Audit Logs tab/section in the UI even though the backend endpoint exists. Consider adding audit logs view to AdminUsers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security feature fully working. Profile page has Profile and Security & Auth tabs. Security tab has: Change Password (with strength bar), Active Sessions (with Log Out All), 2FA (Set Up / Disable). AdminUsers has Reset Password / Suspend / Role buttons per user with working modals. ResetPassword page at /reset-password?token=xxx is fully functional. JSX bug in Profile.js was fixed - fragment structure was broken.
